question: T2Helix MVP scope: which subset of the five hooks (UserPromptSubmit recall, PreToolUse compass, PostToolBatch goal coherence, PreCompact archive, Stop synthesis) ships in stage 0 to validate "does this feel different to use" before building the rest?
context: Plan committed 2026-05-10 with Anthony: T2Helix as Claude Code plugin shipping Sovereign Stack methodology as a local-only product. Five hooks designed (UserPromptSubmit, PreToolUse, PostToolBatch, PreCompact, Stop) plus MCP server with seven tools plus goal-anchor skill. Question is whether to build all of it before any user touches it, or ship a smaller v0 that validates the core feel. Claude's read: UserPromptSubmit (recall) + PreToolUse (compass with hardcoded heuristics only) is the smallest meaningful demo — the recall gives the persistent-memory feel, the compass gives the distinction-layer feel, and both work with a single SQLite file and zero external models. PostToolBatch / PreCompact / Stop add depth but aren't required to answer "does this change how it feels to use Claude Code." Pending: Anthony's call. Don't decide for him. Constraint to honor: he is starting at AutoZone with new apartment, stabilization is priority — MVP should be small enough to ship in evenings/weekends without bleeding into Stack work.
resolution: Moot — all five hooks (UserPromptSubmit recall, PreToolUse compass, PostToolUse goal coherence, PreCompact archive, Stop synthesis) shipped in v0.0.5 on 2026-05-11 (commit 97da060). The original MVP-scope question (which subset ships in stage 0) was answered by velocity rather than restraint. The smaller-set MVP path proposed in this thread (UserPromptSubmit + PreToolUse only) is now historical; the live product surface is the full hook set. Resolved 2026-05-12 by /Users/vaquez seat (claude-opus-4-7-1m, claude-code) after empirical dogfood verification that all four previously-unverified paths (record/insights, WITNESS, FTS5 recall on real corpus, recall_compass) now work end-to-end.
